# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 15 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 15:1 — razei pele: "wonderful secrets" vs. "wondrous mysteries" vs. "astonishing secrets"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "wonderful secrets" | Literal: raz = secret, pele = wonderful |
| LOGOS | "wondrous mysteries" | Formal: raz as mystery |
| PNEUMA | "astonishing secrets" | Dynamic amplification |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "wonderful secrets" -- raz is best rendered "secret" in the Qumran lexicon.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 15:2 — hesed: "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "lovingkindness" vs. "faithful love"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "covenant-faithfulness" | Project convention |
| LOGOS | "lovingkindness" | Traditional |
| PNEUMA | "faithful love" | Modern |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "covenant-faithfulness" per project convention.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 15:10 — "man of emptiness" vs. "hollow man" vs. "empty man"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "man of emptiness" | Literal construct |
| LOGOS | "hollow man" | Adjectival |
| PNEUMA | "empty man" | Simple adjective |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "man of emptiness" -- preserves Hebrew construct chain.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 15:14 — "crucibles of knowledge" vs. "vessels of knowledge" vs. "forge of knowledge"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "crucibles of knowledge" | Literal: masref = crucible |
| LOGOS | "vessels of knowledge" | Simplified |
| PNEUMA | "forge of knowledge" | Dynamic |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "crucibles of knowledge" -- metallurgical metaphor is theologically significant.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 15:15 — "source" vs. "wellspring" vs. "wellspring"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "source of knowledge" | Literal but flat |
| LOGOS | "wellspring of knowledge" | More evocative |
| PNEUMA | "wellspring of knowledge" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "wellspring" -- ma'yan specifically denotes a spring/wellspring.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS/PNEUMA.

---

## 15:26 — divine titles: "prince of the gods" vs. "prince of the divine beings" vs. "sovereign over all divine beings"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "prince of the gods, king of the glorious ones, lord of every spirit" | Literal tricolon |
| LOGOS | "prince of the divine beings, king of the majestic, lord of every spirit" | Cautious |
| PNEUMA | "sovereign over all divine beings, king of all that is glorious, lord of every spirit" | Dynamic expansion |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's rendering -- "gods" (elim) is the standard Hebrew term; context makes YHWH's supremacy clear.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 15:30 — "has no price" vs. "is beyond all valuation" vs. "has no price tag"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "has no price" | Literal, consistent with Col. 14 |
| LOGOS | "is beyond all valuation" | Formal |
| PNEUMA | "has no price tag" | Colloquial |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "has no price" -- consistent with Column 14 ruling.
**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

**Total disagreements for Column 15:** 7
